worker.discovery_notes: 80 distinct employer-level identities were surfaced after collapsing obvious repeated vacancies/employer names across current job-board aggregation pages sourced from hh.ru, Zarplata.ru, SuperJob, Rabota.ru, Habr Career and TrudVsem. Broad jobs search showed >70% duplicate/early-reject saturation, so discovery was rotated away from repeated HH-heavy results toward current multi-source listings. Only candidates with a plausible target-scale fit and strong S1-S3 signal proceeded to deep check. Rejected candidates are not persisted in this qualified-only staging file.
